d: The Great Vestal, Julia, Les Vestales. They come out of the atrium, and sing this hymn in the sacred wood, before going to the temple.

Julia, Licinius, Cinna, La Grande Vestale, Le Sovereign Pontife, Consuls, Senators, Roman Ladies, Vestals, Gladiators, Musicians, Cortege Triomphal, etc. The procession takes place on various sides; it is preceded by a crowd of people who fill the bottom of the scene. Then come the priests of the various temples, at the head of which are the great pontiff, the chief of the aruspices, the senate, the consuls, the matrons, and the warriors. When this first part of the cotege took place, the vestals come out of the temple: the great vestal carries the palladium. As the vestal in charge of the guard of the fire, one carries before Julia a lit altar. The vestals pass before the troops, which render them the supreme honors; the people kneel, the senate bows down, the beams of the consuls are lowered before those of the vestals, carried by four lictors: they take up the tops.
Julia alone, in the attitude of the deepest absolute; she kneels on the steps of the altar, where she remains for a moment prostrate.
Julia, The Supreme Pontiff, Priests, Vestals. Priests enter through the door to the right, vestals through the left. Licinius has come out from the back. The theater lights up.
Licinius, The Supreme Pontiff, The Chief of the Aruspics.

Julia, La Grande Vestale, Les Précédents, People, Priests, Soldiers, Roman Ladies, Young Girls, Vestals, Consuls, etc. Julia, led by liters, is surrounded by her parents and by a choir of young girls. We carry in front of her an altar extinct. The vestals bear the ornaments of the condemned vestal.
